in_sanskrit.name: Diljeet
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Heart's conqueror
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Diljeet एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dil’ meaning heart and ‘jit’ meaning conqueror. In Hindu mythology, Diljeet can be considered the name of a powerful deity who conquers one's heart with love and compassion.
